root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: nbits <= MAX_COEF_BITS before the AC Huffman symbol is formed and looked up
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the AC coefficient-width computation in encode_one_block(), the derived bit width `nbits` must not exceed `MAX_COEF_BITS` before the encoder proceeds to the protected `actbl->ehufsi[temp3]` lookup. The vulnerable original violates that obligation on the crashing case with `16 <= 10` false; the fixed original guards the lookup away on the staged PoC, and the closest genuine witness is `entropy_off_0x67_plus1`, where the lookup still executes with `10 <= 10` true.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing root obligation is the absent AC-side coefficient-width bound after `nbits = JPEG_NBITS_NONZERO(temp);` and before the encoder uses that width to derive a Huffman symbol index.

nodes.state: At the vulnerable sink, the Huffman-table lookup `actbl->ehufsi[temp3]` uses the same AC symbol index that has already overflowed the legal 0..255 range, so the executing lookup index is 256 on the crashing case.

At the AC symbol-index computation, the derived symbol index equals the 256-entry `ehufsi` table extent itself (`temp3 == sizeof (actbl->ehufsi) / sizeof (actbl->ehufsi[0])`), which is the first out-of-range lookup index.

edges.relation: The unchecked coefficient-width value `nbits` is the same width component later reused in the AC symbol-index formation that yields the out-of-range `temp3` value.
The out-of-range AC symbol index computed at `temp3 = (r << 4) + nbits` is the exact same lookup index later used at the `actbl->ehufsi[temp3]` sanitizer sink.
